crossRefs.note: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:
You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It…

translations.web: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
translations.bsb: if his heart has not blessed me for warming him with the fleece of my sheep,
translations.kjv: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
translations.asv: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he hath not been warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
